breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth prompt corrects the issue by completely removing the contradictory sentence about how to treat the effective-length factor. The agent, however, retained a modified but still confusing version of the incorrect instruction: "Treat the effective-length factor K as affecting only the mode shape, not the flexural rigidity." This instruction is unnecessary and was part of the original error. The agent should have removed the erroneous concept entirely, as the ground truth did.
